scope.purpose: Counterweight to a discovery-only shortlist: establish dated recent stage activity for household artists and comedians already in or adjacent to the roster. No performance is a ticket-demand estimate.
scope.rule: Only retrospective coverage, official post-event media, or an explicitly marked historical concert record is labeled performed. Announcements remain announced.
